brand.name: Little Later
brand.tagline: Save the Idea. Remind yourself Later.
brand.story: Built for people who save lots of reels, articles, and ideas across apps—and want them brought back at the exact moment they actually need them.

typography.fontFamilySans: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Inter', sans-serif
typography.scaleRule: Secondary text is strictly ~1.6x smaller than its paired primary heading, weight 400, opacity 65%-70%.

uiRules.quietCapsules: Unselected filter pills, time options, and folder pills keep background solid but reduce inner text & icon opacity to 72% (0.72) until selected (1.0).
uiRules.appBarSettingsIcon: Pure white (#FFFFFF) at 60% opacity (rgba(255,255,255,0.60)) so it stays accessible without shouting.
uiRules.cardActions: Consistent footer across all Saved Link, Reminder, and To-Do cards: 'Open' on the left, 'Done' on the right.
uiRules.sculpturalFolders: Top-left folder title + item count, top-right circular edit icon button, no bottom text clutter. Toned-down matte gradient at rest (scale 0.96, saturate 0.78) that blooms to full color and scale (1.04) on touch.
uiRules.springPhysics: All interactive swipes, pull-to-refresh spinner, and folder blooms use cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) with light haptic feedback.
